bbspp.config.timeline_keyframes.title: Timeline & Keyframes
bbspp.config.timeline_keyframes.tooltip: Timeline, keyframe, and clip track display, navigation, and edit boundaries.
bbspp.config.timeline_keyframes.chinese_: When enabled, track names in the keyframe editor are shown in Chinese for easier identification.
bbspp.config.timeline_keyframes.prevent_: When enabled, keyframes cannot be dragged or added before 0 seconds, preventing negative times.
bbspp.config.timeline_keyframes.reverse_: When enabled, reverses the wheel-driven timeline direction in the film editor: Ctrl+wheel moves the playhead, Alt+wheel moves selected keyframes or clips, and Alt+wheel scrolls the timeline horizontally.
bbspp.config.timeline_keyframes.film_alt: Sets the Alt+wheel timeline mode in the film editor keyframe view when no keyframe is selected; with a selection, Alt+wheel still moves the selected keyframes.
bbspp.config.timeline_keyframes.allow_cl: Create Tracks by Dragging Clips Above the Top
When enabled, dragging a whole clip above the top of the timeline no longer limits track depth, allowing more tracks like vanilla BBS.
bbspp.config.timeline_keyframes.snow_act: When enabled, selecting an action and assigning an animation automatically creates a start keyframe and a paired end keyframe one animation length later, so the action clip can be trimmed, looped, and overlaid. Disabled by default; reopen the film panel or reload the model after toggling.
bbspp.config.pose_animation.title: Pose & Animation
bbspp.config.pose_animation.tooltip: Bones, poses, IK, pivots, and animation state loading.
bbspp.config.pose_animation.direct_paren: When enabled, Shift-clicking a model part in the replay editor selects its parent bone directly instead of opening the hierarchy menu.
bbspp.config.pose_animation.ik_target_cy: Restrict IK Targets to Other Chains

When enabled, the IK target cannot be a bone on the same IK chain (vanilla behavior, prevents cycles); when disabled, chain bones can be selected, but the solve may behave unexpectedly. Use with caution.
bbspp.config.pose_animation.pivot_transf: When enabled, shows the pivot editing row in XYZ transform editors such as Pose.
bbspp.config.pose_animation.pick_limb_te: When enabled, shows the bone texture picker button in the pose editor.
bbspp.config.pose_animation.auto_load_an: Auto-load animation file into animation states

When enabled, opening a model block's animation states manager automatically reads animations/*.animation.json from the model folder, creates a state per animation, sets loop and duration, and bakes keyframes into Pose tracks. Only fills empty states and never overwrites manual edits; on by default.
bbspp.config.pose_animation.transform_tr: How much one click on the field's arrow buttons (or dragging while holding Ctrl) changes a value in the translate (T) row of the XYZ transform editor. Default 1/16 of a block, shown as 0.062.
bbspp.config.pose_animation.transform_sc: How much one click on the field's arrow buttons (or dragging while holding Ctrl) changes a value in the scale (S) row of the XYZ transform editor. Default 0.25.
bbspp.config.pose_animation.transform_ro: How much one click on the field's arrow buttons (or dragging while holding Ctrl) changes a value in the rotation (R) row of the XYZ transform editor, in degrees. Default 15. The quaternion row is not affected.
bbspp.config.pose_animation.transform_pi: How much one click on the field's arrow buttons (or dragging while holding Ctrl) changes a value in the pivot (P) row added by BBS Cubed. Default 1/16 of a block, shown as 0.062.
bbspp.config.shaders.title: Shaders
bbspp.config.shaders.tooltip: Iris shader entry points, in-world playback, and shader curve picking.
bbspp.config.shaders.enable_iris_button-: When enabled and Iris is installed, shows a shader control shortcut button on the right side of the film editor button bar.
bbspp.config.shaders.world_film_shader_c: Apply Shader Curves During In-World Playback
When enabled, sun, weather, sky color, and Iris shader parameters in curve clips also apply when playing films in-world with Right Ctrl.
bbspp.config.shaders.shader_curve_picker: When enabled, adding a shader curve in a curve clip uses the categorized shader curve picker.
bbspp.config.interface_interaction.title: Interface & Interaction
bbspp.config.interface_interaction.toolt: UI layouts, layout locks, keybind hints, editor sessions, and clipboard.
bbspp.config.interface_interaction.new_m: When enabled, the morphing panel uses a two-column layout; when disabled, the original vertical layout is restored.
bbspp.config.interface_interaction.new_f: When enabled, the film selection screen uses the new film library layout and interactions.
bbspp.config.interface_interaction.enabl: When enabled and the keyframe editor layout is locked, the divider between track names and the curve graph is hidden, so the width can no longer be adjusted.
bbspp.config.interface_interaction.locke: Prevent Edge Dragging When Film Layout Is Locked
When enabled, locked film layouts ignore edge dragging; disabled by default.
bbspp.config.interface_interaction.keybi: When enabled, exact-duplicate keybinds on the keybinds page are highlighted in yellow with an exclamation badge; hover to see the conflicts, and click the badge to jump to the row; disabled by default.
bbspp.config.interface_interaction.film_: Auto Spectator Mode in Film Editor
When enabled, automatically switches to spectator mode when the film editor is opened and restores the previous mode when it is closed.
bbspp.config.interface_interaction.priva: When enabled, BBS-specific copy data (replays, keyframes, forms, transforms) is kept inside BBS Cubed instead of the system clipboard; normal text, colors, paths, and commands still use the system clipboard.
bbspp.config.rendering_performance.title: Rendering & Performance
bbspp.config.rendering_performance.toolt: Item spray, model blocks, and other render cost controls.
bbspp.config.rendering_performance.auto_: When enabled, automatically generates config.json with culling=false (face culling disabled) for all models that don't have one. Existing config.json files are untouched.
bbspp.config.rendering_performance.item_: When enabled, item spray particles outside the player's view skip item rendering to reduce frame drops with many particles.
Item spray particles beyond this distance skip rendering; set to 0 to follow the client view distance automatically.
Max Item Spray Particles Per Frame
Limits how many item spray particles can be drawn per frame; set to 0 for no limit.
When IRLights shadow casting is enabled, limits how many item spray particles cast shadows; set to 0 to disable item spray shadows.
bbspp.config.rendering_performance.repla: When enabled, shows sprint particles during replays.
bbspp.config.rendering_performance.fluid: When enabled, fluids interact with the model per bone (cubic models only); when disabled, interaction uses the entity root and is faster.
bbspp.config.rendering_performance.model: BBS hardcodes 512 blocks; lowering this reduces render and picking overhead for distant model blocks. Set to 0 to use the BBS default.
bbspp.config.gizmo_modeling.title: Gizmo & Modeling
bbspp.config.gizmo_modeling.tooltip: Blockbench external editing and gizmo interaction.
bbspp.config.gizmo_modeling.blockbench_p: Path to Blockbench.exe. Once set, right-clicking a user model in the morphing panel opens it in Blockbench; the menu item is grayed out if unset or invalid.
When enabled, opens the .bbmodel project in the model folder if present; otherwise opens the .geo.json model file.
bbspp.config.gizmo_modeling.blockbench_g: When enabled, the gizmo defaults to translate mode; press G/S/R to switch to that mode and press again to restore the previous mode; press T to cycle through Translate → Scale → Rotate.
bbspp.config.gizmo_modeling.gizmo_keep_o: When enabled, pressing G/S/R a second time does not restore the previous mode, keeping vanilla BBS direct-switch behavior.
bbspp.config.export.title: Export
bbspp.config.export.tooltip: Premiere projects, audio, and subtitle export.
bbspp.config.export.export_audio_subtitl: During video export, automatically generates SRT subtitle files containing the audio filenames.
bbspp.config.export.premiere_export_enab: When enabled, shows the Premiere Pro export button on the monitor and generates XMEML v5 XML or SRT after recording; disabled by default.
bbspp.config.export.premiere_export_indi: Exports each AudioClip as a separate WAV for independent editing in Premiere Pro.
bbspp.config.export.premiere_export_audi: When enabled, skips video recording and only exports individual audio and XML/SRT into the package folder.
bbspp.config.export.premiere_export_ntsc: Marks 24/30/60fps as NTSC (23.976/29.97/59.94) to improve Premiere Pro compatibility.
bbspp.config.export.premiere_export_srt-: Generates an SRT subtitle file instead of XML for tools that do not import XML.

bbspp.ui.transforms.ignore_picking_overr:
Limb selection · hold to use
1. Hold this key (E by default) to enter limb picking
2. Left click a model: select the actual limb, ignoring bone picking overrides; when a keyframe editor is open this inserts a keyframe
3. Right click a model: select through the bone picking overrides, also inserting a keyframe
4. While held, the gizmo, axes, camera reference guide and IK debug overlay are hidden, and the model switches to vanilla rendering and draws in front of the other models
5. Release the key to restore everything instantly, no settings are changed
Only works inside BBS screens (model / scene / film preview)

bbsppp.ui.keyframes.texture_tween_block_: Changes neighboring texture pixels as one block. 3x3 or 5x5 reduces fine-grained noise on high-resolution textures.
bbsppp.ui.keyframes.texture_tween_dissip: Controls the sharpness of dissipate spread. Higher values reduce random noise, making the origin clearer and the gradient edge narrower; lower values produce a softer, more natural spread.
When enabled, dissipating pixels show the flash color before becoming transparent. Lower color opacity mixes in more of the original pixel.
bbsppp.ui.keyframes.texture_tween_flash_: Sets the dissipate flash color; lower opacity mixes in more of the original pixel.
bbsppp.ui.keyframes.texture_tween_mode.t: Click to switch the tween effect from this texture keyframe to the next one.
bbsppp.ui.keyframes.texture_tween_origin: Right-click the model surface to choose the origin; left-drag to rotate, middle-drag to pan, and use Ctrl + scroll to zoom. Fine-tune with X/Y/Z.
This model does not support spread origin
The current model lacks parseable 3D geometry (e.g. emoticons, bobj, or other sprite/special-format models), so the spread origin cannot be picked on the model surface.
bbsppp.ui.keyframes.texture_tween_pbr_gl: Makes flashing pixels emissive through the LabPBR specular alpha channel. Requires a shader pack with LabPBR emission support.
Enter 0–100 or drag left and right to set the LabPBR emission strength during the white flash.
bbsppp.ui.keyframes.texture_tween_revers: When enabled, this dissipate segment restores from transparent to the next keyframe texture.
